derivation: Keep the original mount and viewing direction. Construct a static hand-frame box enclosing the nominal capsule under declared grasp-centre and axis deviations. Solve the pinhole inequalities for all corners with six-pixel image border, then round FOV up to the next five degrees. No target state or image/physical outcome enters this design.
primary: Strict complete physical placement, same 30-second budget for every method; keep actual intervention exposure and early aborts separate.
freeze: Register geometry, inherited controller and every method before this cohort. Keep the unsuccessful re-aimed v11 camera cohort. Complete development before deciding whether a method is ready for fresh collection; do not consume fresh cases during tuning.
boundary: Only static robot/capsule design dimensions and lens calibration set the FOV. Networks, acceptance gates, noise, mass, friction, actuators, original grasp geometry and placement/recovery policy unchanged. Independent target truth is evaluation-only.
scope: Development optical-design correction after v11, not a clean preregistered confirmatory comparison with v11 or a novelty claim. Wider FOV changes pixel resolution; keep pose rejections and accepted errors. No new Kaggle run or reserved perception-test evaluation.
